questions.q: Which socket of SamplerCustomAdvanced decides the noise levels?
questions.why: SIGMAS is the list of levels. The sampler only decides how to jump between them.

questions.q: With dpm_2, KSampler and BasicScheduler with the same numbers give different pictures. Why?
options: KSampler alone drops the second to last sigma for that sampler
questions.answer: KSampler alone drops the second to last sigma for that sampler

questions.q: Why does the graph wire the model into BasicScheduler as well as CFGGuider?
options: The scheduler reads the sigma range from the model
questions.answer: The scheduler reads the sigma range from the model
questions.why: calculate_sigmas uses model_sampling, so a patched model must reach it too.

questions.q: What does the second output of SamplerCustomAdvanced give you?
options: The model's estimate of the clean latent
questions.answer: The model's estimate of the clean latent
questions.why: denoised_output comes from the x0 passed to the callback.

questions.q: You want to use a lower CFG for the last few steps. What is the simplest route using these parts?
options: SplitSigmas, then two sampler nodes with different guiders
questions.answer: SplitSigmas, then two sampler nodes with different guiders
questions.why: The two halves share the value at the cut, so nothing is skipped.
